description: A React component for displaying and managing individual post edit history items, including restore and undo functionalities within Mattermost.

methods.name: handleUndo
methods.description: Fetches previous post version from edit history and restores it to undo the latest change.

methods.name: showInfoTooltip
methods.description: Displays a tooltip indicating the message has been restored.

methods.name: handleRestore
methods.description: Restores the selected post version, closes modal, shows tooltip, and removes draft.

methods.name: postHeader
methods.description: Memoized JSX element rendering post author's avatar and profile info.

methods.name: openRestorePostModal
methods.description: Opens modal to confirm restoring a post version.

methods.name: togglePost
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the post's detailed view.
